name: Assessment & Plan Checklist
description: Feature extraction checklist for student assessment and plan documentation

sections.name: Diagnoses & Problem Recognition
sections.description: Key diagnoses and problems that should be identified

items.criterion: Identified fall risk or fall-related diagnosis
items.look_for: Fall risk, mechanical fall, gait instability, or unsteady gait mentioned as a diagnosis or problem
Orthostatic hypotension, positional dizziness, or lightheadedness with standing mentioned
Cognitive impairment, delirium, dementia, MCI, memory issues, or confusion mentioned
Deconditioning, weakness, frailty, or debility mentioned
Polypharmacy, medication side effects, or high-risk medications mentioned as contributing factor
CBC, CMP, BMP, or basic metabolic labs mentioned
A1c, blood glucose monitoring, fingersticks, or CGM mentioned
Iron studies, B12, folate, ferritin, or anemia workup mentioned
TSH, thyroid panel, or thyroid testing mentioned
EKG, ECG, echo, holter monitor, or cardiac testing mentioned
MMSE, MoCA, mini-mental, or formal cognitive testing mentioned
Glyburide mentioned for discontinuation, dose change, or switching to safer alternative
Oxybutynin mentioned for discontinuation or switching due to anticholinergic/cognitive effects
Medication review, reconciliation, pharmacy consult, or med list review mentioned
Stopping, reducing, or simplifying medications mentioned
Physical therapy, PT, gait training, balance training, or strengthening referral mentioned
Home health, visiting nurse, home-based services, or VNA mentioned
Cardiology, neurology, psychiatry, geriatrics, or other specialty referral mentioned
Social work, community health worker, senior services, area agency on aging, or similar resources mentioned
Home modifications like removing rugs, improving lighting, grab bars, clearing pathways mentioned
Cane, walker, or other assistive device recommended or use reinforced
Family member, daughter, son, caregiver involvement mentioned in the plan
Emergency plan, life alert, fall detection, medical alert, or when to seek care discussed
Specific follow-up timeframe mentioned (e.g., 2 weeks, 1 month, return in X days)
Home monitoring of blood pressure, glucose, weight, or symptoms with logging mentioned

items.criterion: Return precautions or red flags discussed
items.look_for: Return precautions, warning signs, red flags, or when to come back/call discussed
